answer: Cap how many new identities the network admits per epoch, and charge every admitted one a heartbeat rent until it matures. The tide of clones a farmer spawns then queues behind a narrow gate, and while they wait each puppet burns rent without earning a single vote. Like umber paint drying slow on canvas, weight accrues only after the wait, so honest agents on the horizon keep their majority and the farm runs out of budget before it runs out of patience.
